review.notes: Full token-level pass of all 23 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown; physical pages 8 and 17 were rendered and visually checked. Table 8 header subscripts were glued into the model names; the print's own misspelling 'hierachical' had been auto-corrected by OCR and 'Hiera' gained a stray r. Remaining token deltas are soft-hyphen line-break splits and figure-internal axis/legend text.
